tasks.name: Create Quote Entity Model
tasks.description: Implement Quote dataclass model in src/models/quote.py following existing Client/Invoice patterns. The Quote model represents Jobber quotes/estimates with all required fields for line items, totals, and metadata. Must use @dataclass(frozen=True) pattern and built-in types for UP035 compliance.
tasks.notes: Follow exact patterns from src/models/client.py and src/models/invoice.py. Use int for monetary values (converted to cents) like existing total_cents in Invoice model. Store complex data (line_items) as JSON string in str field for SQLite TEXT storage.

relatedFiles.description: Reference for field naming and foreign key patterns

tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Create src/models/quote.py with @dataclass(frozen=True) decorator
2. Define fields: id (str), client_id (str), quote_number (str), title (str), total (int for cents), subtotal (int for cents), disclaimer (str), line_items (str for JSONB), created_at (str), transitioned_at (str), updated_at (str)
3. Add comprehensive docstring explaining Jobber GraphQL Quote schema alignment
4. Follow exact field naming and type patterns from existing Client/Invoice models
5. Use str type for JSONB fields to store JSON arrays as TEXT
6. Maintain foreign key naming convention (client_id) matching Invoice model
tasks.verificationCriteria: Quote model instantiates correctly with all required fields, follows @dataclass(frozen=True) pattern, uses only built-in types (str, int), includes comprehensive docstring, and maintains naming consistency with existing models.
tasks.analysisResult: Implementation of Phase 4 Enhanced Jobber Coverage: Schema & Models task for TightBeam v2 MVP. This involves creating 3 new entity models (Quote, Note, Attachment), enhancing existing Client and Invoice models with additional fields, and updating the Repository class with new database schema and CRUD operations. All implementation follows established architectural patterns including dataclass usage with frozen=True, SQLite schema design with foreign key relationships, UP035 compliance, and seamless integration with existing EntityMapper and Repository patterns.
tasks.summary: Successfully implemented Quote dataclass model in src/models/quote.py with all required fields, @dataclass(frozen=True) pattern, built-in types only, comprehensive docstring, and full compliance with existing Client/Invoice model patterns. Model passes all verification tests including import, instantiation, immutability, and UP035 type compliance.

tasks.notes: This model enables flexible note attachment to any entity type using polymorphic relationship pattern. Entity_type field acts as discriminator for the polymorphic relationship to support future entity types.

relatedFiles.description: Reference for dataclass patterns and field ordering

3. Add comprehensive docstring explaining polymorphic entity relationship design
4. Follow existing Client/Invoice field ordering (id first, relationship fields next, data fields last)
5. Use str types for all fields to maintain UP035 compliance
6. Document entity_type enum values in docstring for clear usage

tasks.name: Implement Enhanced Table Migration for Existing Models
tasks.description: Add schema migration logic to Repository for enhancing existing clients and invoices tables with new fields. Implement conditional ALTER TABLE statements to add additional_emails, additional_phones to clients table and due_date, subtotal, line_items to invoices table while preserving existing data.
tasks.notes: Establishes migration pattern for future schema evolution while maintaining full backward compatibility. New columns default to NULL for existing records.

relatedFiles.description: Repository class to add migration logic for existing tables

tasks.implementationGuide:
1. Create _migrate_existing_tables() private method in Repository
2. Implement column existence checking using PRAGMA table_info()
3. Add conditional ALTER TABLE clients ADD COLUMN statements for additional_emails, additional_phones
4. Add conditional ALTER TABLE invoices ADD COLUMN statements for due_date, subtotal, line_items
5. Use DEFAULT NULL for new columns to maintain backward compatibility
6. Follow existing error handling patterns with RepositoryError
7. Call _migrate_existing_tables() from init_schema() after table creation
tasks.verificationCriteria: Repository successfully adds new columns to existing tables when they don't exist, preserves existing data, handles migration errors gracefully, follows established error handling patterns, and maintains backward compatibility.
